blocks.x: The first question about any office renovation is cost, and the honest answer is "it depends on scope." Office renovation cost in Winnipeg can be very different for a paint-and-carpet refresh than for a full reconfiguration with new walls, washrooms and HVAC.

That's why this guide gives no dollar or per-square-foot figures: no reliable number exists without seeing the space, including what's behind the walls, what the building requires and the hours you need to stay open. The best way to budget is to define your scope first, then price it.
Office renovation cost in Winnipeg: the four scope levels

head: Level
What's included
Disruption
Relative cost
rows: Paint, carpet tile or vinyl, ceiling tiles, LED lighting
Level 1 plus new walls, doors, meeting rooms, electrical and data
Level 2 plus washrooms, kitchenette, HVAC changes, millwork
Level 3 plus accessibility, fire separations, envelope or code upgrades

blocks.x: Many projects mix levels: a refreshed open area with a few new rooms, for example. The disruption and relative cost ratings above are a rough guide, not published data or a quote.
What pushes office renovation cost up
**Moving plumbing** (washrooms, kitchenettes) away from existing lines
**HVAC changes** to serve new rooms
**Electrical capacity** for more equipment
**Code upgrades** triggered by the work: accessibility, exits, fire separations
**Older buildings:** asbestos testing and abatement, uneven floors, outdated wiring
**After-hours work** to keep your office open
**Premium finishes:** glass walls, custom millwork, high-end flooring
What keeps it down
Reusing existing walls, ceilings and mechanical systems
Keeping kitchenettes and washrooms near existing plumbing
Choosing durable mid-range finishes
Making design decisions early and avoiding mid-project changes
Using your landlord's [tenant improvement allowance](/blog/tenant-improvement-allowance-winnipeg), if your lease has one, to offset part of the cost
Don't forget soft costs
Budget beyond construction for:
Design and drawings (architect or designer)
City of Winnipeg [permit fees](https://www.winnipeg.ca/building-development/fees-charges)
Furniture, IT, AV and security
Moving and temporary space
Signage
A [contingency fund](https://www.bdc.ca/en/articles-tools/money-finance/buy-lease-commercial-real-estate/how-to-protect-your-business-when-making-lease-hold-improvements), larger for older buildings
A simple budgeting worksheet
Fill in the right-hand column from your own quotes and lease. It starts blank on purpose, because no figure we printed here would be reliable for your space.
How to get a reliable number
Write a short brief: headcount, rooms needed, equipment, hours you need to stay open.
Share your floor plan and photos.
Book an on-site visit. A firm office renovation cost needs eyes on the space.
Compare quotes line by line, including allowances and exclusions.
The bottom line
Office renovation cost follows scope. Decide what level of renovation you need, plan for soft costs and contingency, and get a site-specific quote before you commit.
